rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
conjunction adding to the preceding list
compound with internal sandhi: siddhisaṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) + mūlakaulaṃ (root Kaula)

items.question: What additional attainment is identified as the root Kaula, O fair-faced one?
premises: The attainment of powers is named.
This attainment is identified as the root Kaula.
items.inference: Alongside the eight powers, the attainment of powers constitutes the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between the eight and the attainment of powers is compressed in this fused token.
items.plain_english: And the eight, O fair-faced one, along with the attainment of the siddhis, constitute the root Kaula.
